name: Historic Museum Quarter
description: Compact galleries, local history rooms, and a shaded plaza for a quick pause.

name: Local Street Food Market
description: Fast regional bites, fresh juice counters, and a lively lunch-hour atmosphere.

name: Riverside Park and Gardens
description: A relaxed green stop with river views, benches, and an easy photo route.

name: Independent Design Arcade
description: Small makers, postcards, ceramics, and gift shops grouped under one arcade.

name: Old Town Walking Lanes
description: Narrow streets, heritage facades, and short plaques that make the route self-guided.

name: Sunset Belvedere
description: A small viewpoint with murals, skyline angles, and golden-hour photo spots.
